sara (CEO): Quick exec pulse — please read before EOD. TL;DR: approving Private GA for EU next Tue. Key asks: freeze infra churn for 48h during rollout; enforce cost guardrails (<12% infra uplift); update default data retention to 90 days with opt-in 1yr. Flag blockers now. :loudspeaker:
vikram (VP Product): Copy. I'm prepping the rollout checklist. Can we confirm canary size + rollback window? My recommendation: 5% traffic canary, 2h ramp, 24h observation.
ana (Head of Eng): We can run 5% canary in eu-west on dedicated clusters. Plan: staggered hosts, health probes, automatic fallback to hosted. Need infra freeze + deployment tagging for any changes. I'll drop the canary playbook in #eng-runtime.
michael (CFO): Quick finance note — model predicts ~+9% infra run rate month 1. If we exceed 12% uplift we trigger a cost review and pause. Cost center owners, be ready to reclassify burst spend to SR.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: canary window queued 2026-03-24T09:00Z -> 2026-03-25T09:00Z. Rolling updates will follow the tagged canary policy.
vikram (VP Product): Also — policy change on retention needs customer comms. @priya (Legal) / @ana can you work on an FAQ and short customer note? Prefer short language + migration steps.
priya (Legal): On it. Drafting FAQ now; will include KMS note, data export instructions, and opt-in process for extended retention. ETA 18:00 tomorrow.
ana (Head of Eng): One operational ask: pause non-critical infra migrations and feature toggles that touch inference infra until the GA window closes. Oncall + release managers please ack.
sara (CEO): Two concrete asks: (1) Product — one-pager for sales outlining GA limits, known issues, and SLAs; (2) Eng — publish runbook and signal thresholds in Console (link to signal alerts). I'm hosting a 30-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk the checklist.
michael (CFO): We'll prepare a 90-day cost sensitivity doc for leadership and sales to reference.
vikram (VP Product): Noted. One-pager draft to you by EOD. @ana will share runbook link once uploaded.
sara (CEO): :thumbsup: Good. If anything looks like it will push GA past Tue, flag here immediately and mark blocker in the rollout doc. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
